findings.title: Firebase email identity accepted without email_verified, letting an attacker obtain recovery signatures for a victim's account
Sign route co-signs for any Firebase session whose unverified email matches a registered identity
Firebase ID tokens are not checked for revocation, so disabled users keep signing access until token expiry
Empty SEP-10 issuer is passed through unchecked, so any token signed by the configured JWK is accepted
Sign endpoint signs any operation of a registered account without inspecting operations, destinations or amounts
Sign endpoint signs any operation of a registered account without inspecting operations, destinations or amounts
Sign handler signs transactions with no time bounds, so issued server signatures never expire

findings.title: Unique-violation path in Add returns without rolling back, leaking a DB connection per duplicate POST
Account query leaks DB rows on scan error and ignores iteration errors
SEP-10 issuer check is skipped when sep10-jwt-issuer is unset, so tokens minted for other services under the same key are accepted
Unverified email lets any Firebase user enumerate accounts registered under that email
Agent signing seed accepted as a command-line flag, exposing it in process arguments and shell history
